title: Entomancer

moves.title: Agitate Swarm
effects: If Hive stacks < 3: Apply 1 Personal Hive and 1 Strength

move_pattern: Cycles: Beeeees! → Spear! → Agitate Swarm → Beeeees!
notes: Personal Hive is a stacking power that determines Pheromone Spit behavior. When stacks reach 3, the move shifts from building hives to applying raw Strength instead, making the Entomancer increasingly dangerous as combat progresses.
